statement: The Minister may prescribe model constitutions for private companies and companies limited by guarantee; such a company may adopt the whole or any part of the prescribed model constitution as its constitution, either as in force at the time of adoption or as in force from time to time, and must submit a copy of its constitution with the registration application where it adopts only part of the model, includes additional provisions, or includes object clauses.
caveat: The prescribed texts live in the Companies (Model Constitutions) Regulations 2015. A company adopting the model 'as in force from time to time' tracks later amendments automatically; most venture-backed companies replace the model with bespoke articles at the first priced round.
